title: Charles McCormack, President of the Hartland Bridge Com. and Superintendent during its construction
description: This is one of the stereoscope pictures, which uses two slightly different angles to create a sense of natural depth when viewed. The photo was taken by Charles McCormack, President of the Hartland Bridge Company and Superintendent of bridge construction, after the bridge was completed. New photo enhancement technology has revealed a sign on the bridge that reads: “Tool Bridge Forty Dollar Fine for Driving Your Animals on this Bridge Faster Than a Walk.” (Photo courtesy of Charles McCormack’s family)
